attested.notes: Second pass this session, run against editorial-os/docs/human-authorship-voice-engine.md after the first pass was judged not to have gone far enough. Measured against that file's own self-audit checklist, the page had failed six of its requirements: we/our below the stated 5/1k minimum, no rhetorical question mirroring the reader's real question, no attitude-bearing transitions, no British texture at all, no tone shift where the subject turns punitive, and an ending that drifted instead of compressing the decision. All six addressed. we/our now 5.1/1k reached through 'we' that shows labour per Rule H, not polish. Added: the reader's own question ('So which one should you act on first?'), 'On paper... In practice' on the statement-of-affairs timing, moral framing on the automatic bank freeze ('Nobody is obliged to warn you first. The advertisement is the warning, and it is aimed at your creditors'), a protective steer on the 21-day criminal-offence deadline, bite on late creditor claims ('A good debt and a late claim are worth exactly the same, which is nothing'), one earned UK register word ('grim') where the operational pain is real, and a compressed ending replacing neutral drift. Second stranger read then caught the over-correction: it named 'The deadlines that cost the most are the ones nobody writes to you about' as a line built to land rather than inform, and I cut it. It also found a genuine confusion between the three-business-day and fourteen-day figures in the opening, now reconciled in one sentence, and a whiplash pair on which clocks are running, now one sentence. Glossed 'statement of affairs' and 'Official Receiver' inline as it asked. It flagged the same unevidenced usually/often claims for the second time, so both were cut and replaced with the rule itself rather than a frequency assertion. Re-scanned the whole page for repeated shapes after adding material: the 'not X, but Y' contrast had reached five instances, trimmed back to two. 'you' hit 30.3/1k over the ceiling after the additions; cut the three that did no work, now 29.0/1k, still above this file's 15-20 target and worth watching. Rhythm cv 0.380. Scenes counted (5) are practitioner knowledge, not invented scene. Bite lines counted (4). Protected sentence intact. No new facts, headings or links.
